words: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍۢ سَوَآءٍۭ
rows.speaker: عبد الله بن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās transmits that the Prophet sent Heraclius a call to Islam; the letter quotes 3:64, inviting the People of the Book to worship God alone, without partners or human lords.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الله بن عباس ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أنه أخبره أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كتب إلى قيصر يدعوه إلى الإسلام

none: The report concerns the Prophet’s first revelation; it neither quotes nor explains 6:128.
The report concerns ʿĀʾisha’s lost necklace and the revelation of tayammum, with no link to 6:128.

rows.speaker: أبو هريرة
rows.claim: Abū Hurayra reports that on resurrection day people follow what they worshiped and are judged; this parallels 6:128’s gathering and punishment scene, though the report does not mention the jinn-human alliance.
rows.anchor: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ

none: The report concerns ʿUmar’s silk garment; it does not address 6:128.
